data.completion_memo: Created and executed the complete Milestone 10 automated QA gate. Coverage includes redaction and physical retention bounds, crash recovery and exact unavailable states, stable recurring-error grouping/regression, transition and receipt integrity, bounded authority and token budgets, artifact exact-read gates, candidate/version conflicts, disclosure completeness, rejection/defer paths, capability/enrollment/unsupported presentation, helper-mediated activation/rollback, idempotent crash redrives, durable multi-group native replay, stale/cross-group/race rejection, keyboard focus, accessibility, TypeScript, and production build. The lazy route integration boundary was stress-run five times after increasing its asynchronous test wait to remove a CI-only one-second flake. qa/milestone-10.sh passed locally, and Adashi QA job 10 run group 28 / QA run 28 passed with exit code 0. The script uses RUSTFLAGS=-D warnings because Rust 1.97 Clippy currently stops on documented pre-existing pedantic debt in earlier protocol/local-store modules.
data.description: Create automated QA tests for Milestone 10. Cover redaction and retention, recurring-error grouping and regression state, bounded investigation, artifact/evidence integrity, candidate version conflicts, complete disclosure, rejection, Supported/EnrollmentRequired/Unsupported presentation, keyboard/accessibility behavior, and proof that review cannot activate or broaden authority by itself.
data.title: M10.QA — Create QA tests for diagnostics and repair review
